voice_prefix: [excited] Whoa, whoa, whoa. I've seen your bank history! [laughs] Four coffees, two takeouts, AND a quick little online order? On a TUESDAY? [smug] Relax, pal. I'm a raccoon. I know exactly where money disappears to.
sentences: [smug] Okay. We need rules. And no, rule one isn't stop ordering.
Rule one. Savings leaves the day you get paid. Not if there's something left.
Rule two. One daily number. Not a forty-line budget.
Rule three. Overspent today? Tomorrow pays. Not your savings.
[mischievous] See, it's not spend less. It's spend in the right order. Which brings me to rule four.
[happy] Takeout's allowed. It's in the plan.
Save first. Then spend what's safe. Try it at Divvyup dot com.

header.text: Not spend less. Spend in the right order.
